about:
# SideQuest Guild

A World of Warcraft: Forever addon for the SideQuest guild. Members use it to see the roster, find crafters, sign up
for events and check their loot points. Officers use it to run raid nights, hand out loot and send the night's record
to [sidequest-guild.com](https://sidequest-guild.com/).

![The You tab: your points, your next event, who's online and guild news](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SideQuest-Guild/addon/main/docs/screenshots/you.jpg)

These pictures are drawn outside the game from the addon's own code and art, with WoW: Forever's own window frame,
tabs and icons, and made-up guild members. Lighting and a few small details differ in game.

## Install

Install **SideQuest Guild** from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/projects/1773662) with the CurseForge app, or
download the zip from [GitHub releases](https://github.com/SideQuest-Guild/addon/releases) and unzip it into
`_forever_/Interface/AddOns/`. You should end up with `Interface/AddOns/SideQuest/SideQuest.toc`.

CurseForge and GitHub get the same zip, built by GitHub Actions and signed. [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/SideQuest-Guild/addon/blob/main/SECURITY.md) shows how to
check that a zip you downloaded came from this repo.

[SideQuest Companion](https://github.com/SideQuest-Guild/companion/releases) also installs and updates the addon, and
by default does so on its own, even while WoW is running. The game keeps the old version until you `/reload`; when
Companion has installed an update, SideQuest says so in game with a **Reload now** button.

In game, click the crest on the minimap or type `/sq` to open the window. Drag the crest round the minimap to move it.
If you aren't in the SideQuest guild yet, this opens a single join window instead, with the website and Discord
links and how to ask for an invite; the full window opens automatically once you're a member.
Settings such as the minimap button, window scale and directory sharing are also in the game menu, under
**Options > AddOns > SideQuest Guild** (or type `/sq options`).

## Loot points

Raid loot goes by points. You earn EP (effort points) for raiding: 10 for each boss kill, 10 for the first night the
guild wipes on a boss it hasn't killed, 5 for being there at the start and 5 for staying to the end. Standby earns the
same. You spend GP (gear points) when you win an item, and everyone starts at 100 GP.

Your PR (priority) is your EP divided by your GP. When several people want an item for their main spec, the highest PR
wins it. Both EP and GP shrink by 15% each week, so recent raids count for more than old ones.

The full rules and prices are on the [Ledger page](https://sidequest-guild.com/ledger/).

## For members

![The Guild tab: the roster with search and filters](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SideQuest-Guild/addon/main/docs/screenshots/guild.jpg) ![The Ledger tab: everyone's EP, GP and PR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SideQuest-Guild/addon/main/docs/screenshots/ledger.jpg)

| Tab | What it shows |
|---|---|
| You | Your PR and where it ranks, your last four weeks of points, your next event with Going, Maybe and Can't buttons, and who's online. |
| Guild | The roster, with alts under their main. Search it, filter by class, rank or online, and whisper or invite from it. Whisper opens a small SideQuest box: replies come back in chat as usual. Online guildmates show in green, offline in grey. |
| Crafters | Search a recipe or profession to see who can make it, online people first; every member with a profession and their skill, including guildies who are offline or don't run the addon, from the site's last sync; and who has Transmute, Mooncloth and other craft cooldowns ready (addon-tracked members only). |
| Market | What guildmates sell and want to buy, open requests for materials, and who holds an item, with the guild's lowest auction-house price next to each listing when one's known. Mine lists and edits your own. |
| Events | Upcoming events, how many have signed up for each role, and your own answer, then the last 30 days' past events with how many went. A recruitment drive stays listed until it ends and shows its rules, its leaderboard (qualified, potential and invited recruits per inviter) and each recruit's status instead of a sign-up. |
| Ledger | Everyone's EP, GP and PR, then your own points history and loot. |
| News | Guild announcements and recent activity. |

Click someone on the Guild tab to see their level, spec, item level, professions, Onyxia attunement, tracked
reputations and cooldowns; whichever of item level, spec, professions and reputations the addon hasn't scanned live
comes from the site's last sync instead, marked "(from Battle.net)" since it can be a few hours stale. Hover any item
to see which guildmates craft, sell, buy or hold it, how many have it on their wishlist, and the guild's lowest
auction-house price if a sync has priced it.

Your event sign-ups are saved to your own export every time you log out, reload, or quit the game. SideQuest
Companion uploads them straight away. Without it, your sign-ups still reach the website the next time an officer
syncs.

During a recruitment drive, invite new players to the guild as usual. Whoever brings in the most recruits who stay 7
days and reach level 10 wins 1g, and ties each win 1g. Who invited whom comes straight from the guild's own event
log, so you don't need the addon to win. Payouts go out a week after the drive ends. The Events tab shows the drive's
leaderboard as of the last site data; "potential" recruits joined and are still inside their 7 days.

If you can come to a raid but the group is full, type `/sq standby`. An officer approves it and you earn EP as if you
were there.

## What the addon shares

SideQuest keeps a record of your character and shares it with the guild automatically: your professions and skill,
your level, class, spec and item level, your craft cooldowns, your Onyxia attunement and the few reputations the guild
tracks, what you sell and want to buy, and the crafting materials in your bags and bank (never gold or gear). That's
how the Crafters and Market tabs work for guildmates who are offline but have run the addon recently; a site sync
fills in the rest -- crafters, item level, spec, professions, tracked reputations and wishlist counts -- for guildies
who are offline or have never installed it, and officers' syncs carry it to the website, where only signed-in guild
members see it.

Turn any part off on the You tab, or with `/sq share <prof|char|cd|market|stock> on|off`. `/sq dir` shows what you
share and how many guildmates the addon has heard from. Open each profession window once so the guild knows your
recipes; skill levels update by themselves.

![The Crafters tab: every Tailor in the guild with their skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SideQuest-Guild/addon/main/docs/screenshots/crafters.jpg) ![The Market tab: who sells, holds and asks for an item](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SideQuest-Guild/addon/main/docs/screenshots/market.jpg)

### Selling, buying and asking for materials

Use the Market tab's Mine view, or these commands. An item can be a shift-clicked link, an item ID, or a name in
quotes.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/sq sell <item> <price> [qty] [crafted]` | List something you sell, for example `/sq sell "Bolt of Runecloth" 1g20s 20`. |
| `/sq buy <item> <price>` | Put up a standing offer to buy a material. |
| `/sq request <item> <qty> [price] [note]` | Ask the guild for materials you need. |
| `/sq unrequest <item>` | Take a request down. |

Prices are gold, silver and copper (`1g20s`, `35s`, `80c`) or a plain number of gold (`1.5`). Leave the price off and
buyers whisper you instead. With Auctionator or TradeSkillMaster installed, the Mine view suggests a price.

## Battleground scoreboards

When you finish a battleground, SideQuest records the final scoreboard: the map, who won, and every player's kills,
deaths, honor, damage and healing. An officer's next sync carries it to the website, where signed-in guild members
can see match history and guild PvP leaderboards.

## For officers

![The Raid Night tab: tonight's steps, who's present and standby](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SideQuest-Guild/addon/main/docs/screenshots/console-raid-night.jpg) ![The Loot tab: bids ranked by PR with Award buttons](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SideQuest-Guild/addon/main/docs/screenshots/console-loot.jpg)

Officers get a gold **Console** tab. The addon treats you as an officer if your guild rank can edit officer notes. If
your officer ranks can't, pick the lowest rank that should count (the Guild Master is 0, the rank below is 1, and so on)
and run this once:

```
/run SideQuestDB.settings.officerRankIndex = 1
```

### Running a raid night

Zone into the raid and click **Start recording** at the top of the Console's **Raid Night** tab (only officers in a
raid instance can; the button says why if you can't). The **Who can record** list below it shows every officer
SideQuest has heard from recently and whether they're already recording, so two officers don't record the same
night by accident -- clicking Start again when someone else is already recording asks you to confirm first.

Then follow the steps:

1. **Prep** asks the raid to report food, flasks and repairs.
2. **Invite** invites everyone who signed up on the website.
3. **Start raid** gives everyone present 5 EP for being on time. It only unlocks once you're recording.
4. Boss kills and wipes are recorded on their own. A kill gives 10 EP. The first wipe of the night on a boss the guild
   hasn't killed gives 10 EP, once per boss per night.
5. **Loot** opens bidding on each item in the loot window. Raiders get a popup with the item, its GP price, their PR and
   Main, Off and Pass buttons. The Loot tab lists the answers in the order the rules give: main spec by PR, then off
   spec, alts and disenchant. Chase items (one per boss), legendaries/specials/rares and crafted tier are decided by
   the loot council instead: pick the winner and the item in the Loot tab's **Council award** form, its kind (Chase,
   Legendary or Tier -- Tier also asks which slot), and write a one-line reason, which is posted to #loot-log on the
   site. The winner still pays full GP; Award stays disabled until every field is filled in.
6. **End raid** gives 5 EP to everyone still there. It unlocks once you're recording, and doesn't stop recording by
   itself -- click **Stop recording** (or type `/sq record`) when the night is over.

Every award prints a chat line with an undo command, and the Raid Night tab has an **Undo** button next to each one.

The other Console tabs:

| Tab | What it does |
|---|---|
| Loot | Bidding and awards, as above. If you aren't master looter, `/sq bid <item link>` opens bidding on any item. |
| Roster | Reads the guild roster for the website and lists inactive members. |
| Recruits | An Add recruit form that fills in your target, plus applicants and trials with yes/no votes from officers. |
| Payouts | Recruitment drive winners and their prize, settled a week after each drive ends. Stand at a mailbox and click Mail to send it; nothing sends until then, and a row disappears once it's paid. |
| Bank | Lists everyone who has used the guild bank, biggest giver first: gold and items put in (items valued at the guild's auction prices) and gold, repairs and items taken out. It also saves the open tab's log for the website. These totals only count what your own copy of the addon has read from the bank log; the website's Guild page adds up every officer's reads, counts each member's characters together, and shows the totals to all members. The game keeps only each tab's latest entries, so open every tab now and then. |
| Announce | Posts a message to guild chat and every member's News tab, and to Discord if you tick the box. |
| Sync | Shows what hasn't been sent to the website yet, with Export and Import buttons. **Update calendar** puts the site's upcoming events on the in-game guild calendar. |
| Debug | Guild Master only. Lists what the game blocked SideQuest from doing and errors the addon caught, with a box to copy them. **View as** shows the windows as a non-member, member or officer sees them; **Back to my view**, closing the window or `/sq viewas off` ends it. |

### The guild calendar

After an import, the Sync tab says how many of the site's upcoming events aren't on the in-game calendar yet. Click
**Update calendar** (or type `/sq calendar`) once for each: the game only lets an addon add a calendar event when you
click, so it's one event per click. Each goes on as a guild event at the realm's time, with a link to its sign-up
page (WoW: Forever has no guild announcements). Sign-ups still happen on the site and in the addon; signing up on the
calendar itself doesn't reach the site. A recruitment drive gets two locked "Other" events, since it takes no
sign-ups: its title when it starts, and "Ends: " when it ends. When the site moves an event, or a drive event
is there unlocked or as another type, it takes two clicks: one opens the event, the next saves it. WoW: Forever
doesn't let an addon delete a guild event, so a cancelled one is named in chat for you to delete by hand (right-click
it, Delete). Your guild rank needs the right to add guild events.

### Commands

| Command | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/sq` | everyone | Opens or closes the window. |
| `/sq standby` | everyone | Asks to be on standby tonight. Officers in the raid add themselves. |
| `/sq record` | officers | Starts or stops recording the raid you're in, same as the Raid Night tab's button. |
| `/sq help` | everyone | Lists every command. |
| `/sq minimap` | everyone | Hides or shows the minimap button. |
| `/sq options` | everyone | Opens the SideQuest settings panel (Options > AddOns > SideQuest Guild). |
| `/sq scale <0.75-2>` | everyone | Makes the window bigger or smaller (1.25 by default); `/sq scale reset` goes back. |
| `/sq export` | officers | Makes the text to paste into the website. |
| `/sq export clear` | officers | Clears what was sent, once the website has accepted it. |
| `/sq import` | officers | Loads points and events from the website. |
| `/sq calendar` | officers | Makes the next change that puts the site's events on the in-game guild calendar. |
| `/sq roster` | officers | Reads the guild roster now. |
| `/sq share <prof\|char\|cd\|market\|stock> on\|off` | everyone | Turns a part of your shared directory record on or off. |
| `/sq dir` | everyone | Shows directory sharing status and how many characters are known. |
| `/sq bid <item link>` | officers | Opens bidding on an item that isn't in the loot window. |
| `/sq undo <id>` | officers | Cancels a points award or loot record. |

## Sending a raid night to the website

After the raid, the record has to reach the website. Pick whichever is easiest:

1. Run [SideQuest Companion](https://github.com/SideQuest-Guild/companion/releases), a tray app for Windows, macOS
   and Linux. It watches the save file and uploads a new export the moment WoW writes it, so there's nothing to copy
   or paste. It also keeps the website's newest import ready in its own small `SideQuest_Inbox` addon, so an
   officer's next `/reload` or login picks up the new points and events on its own. The first time, restart WoW once
   so the game notices `SideQuest_Inbox`.
2. Type `/sq export`, copy the text and paste it on the [sync page](https://sidequest-guild.com/officers/sync/).
3. Upload the addon's save file on the same page. It is at
   `_forever_/WTF/Account/<your account>/SavedVariables/SideQuest.lua`, and WoW writes it when you log out or type
   `/reload`.
4. Let `sidequest-sync` upload it for you, as below.

When the website confirms the import, type `/sq export clear` so the next night starts empty. SideQuest Companion
stages the new import on its own, so an officer running it just needs to log in; everyone else clicks **Import** on
the sync page's text and pastes it with `/sq import`. Once one officer imports, the addon shares the new points and
events with every member online, and members who log in later get them from any officer online.

### sidequest-sync

`sidequest-sync` is a small program that finds the save file and uploads it whenever it changes. It needs
[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). Get a sync token from the [sync page](https://sidequest-guild.com/officers/sync/)
first; the site shows it only once.

```sh
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/SideQuest-Guild/addon#subdirectory=uploader" sidequest-sync login
uvx --from "git+https://github.com/SideQuest-Guild/addon#subdirectory=uploader" sidequest-sync watch
```

When the website confirms the import, type `/sq export clear` so the next night starts empty. Then click **Copy game
import string** on the sync page and paste it into `/sq import` in game. Once one officer imports, the addon shares the
new points and events with every member online.

## Not yet tested on Forever

Nobody has run the addon on a live Forever server yet. These parts may not work there, and the addon tells you when one
fails:

- Addon messages inside a raid. If the bidding popup can't reach raiders, award loot by hand from the Loot tab and read
  points out in voice chat.
- Master loot, which arrives with the raids on December 9. You can always record who got an item from the Loot tab.
- The guild bank log and recipe lists. If the game doesn't offer them, the Bank and Crafters tabs say so.
- The save file was unreliable during the beta. Export a few times during a long night instead of only at the end.
- Adding guild calendar events. If the game refuses, the addon prints its reason; add the event from the calendar by
  hand.

## Development

The addon is in `SideQuest/`, `sidequest-sync` is in `uploader/`, and the tests are in `tests/`. The tests run outside
the game against a fake copy of the WoW functions the addon uses.

```sh
luajit tests/run_tests.lua           # addon tests
luacheck SideQuest tests             # lint
uv run --directory uploader pytest   # uploader tests
```

The tests also write `tests/fixtures/export_v1.txt`, `export_v2.txt`, `export_v2_directory.txt` and
`export_v2_guild_log.txt`, sample raid, directory and recruitment records that the website's tests import. Copy
them to the website repo when they change.

The minimap button is drawn by LibDBIcon-1.0 (Ace3-style BSD licence), which needs LibStub (public domain),
CallbackHandler-1.0 (BSD) and LibDataBroker-1.1 (public domain). They're copied unchanged into `SideQuest/Libs/` from
LibDBIcon's trunk on CurseForge, and luacheck skips them. To update them, copy the new files over.

`tests/preview/` draws every tab and popup as an image so you can check the layout without the game. See
[tests/preview/README.md](https://github.com/SideQuest-Guild/addon/blob/main/tests/preview/README.md).

### Releasing

Commit subjects follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/). [git-cliff](https://git-cliff.org/)
builds `CHANGELOG.md` from them; `feat`, `fix` and `perf` commits are listed and the rest are left out.

```sh
git cliff --tag v0.2.0 -o CHANGELOG.md
git commit -am "docs: changelog for v0.2.0"
git tag -s v0.2.0 -m "SideQuest v0.2.0"
git push origin main v0.2.0
```

Pushing the tag starts the release workflow. It writes that version's notes with git-cliff, builds the zip and uploads
it to CurseForge, signs build provenance and an SBOM for it, and publishes it as a GitHub release. A published
release's files can't be changed, and `v*` tags can't be moved or deleted, so a bad release is fixed with a new version.

To test the workflow without releasing, run it by hand from the Actions tab with the tag left blank. It builds and
signs the zip, uploads nothing to CurseForge, and leaves a draft release named `dry-run-<run id>` that you can delete.
Running it by hand with an existing tag, such as `v0.1.0`, publishes that tag as a GitHub release without uploading it
to CurseForge again.

`main` takes signed commits only, and force pushes and deleting it are blocked.

## v0.18.0 (2026-11-16)

### New

- The Bank tab shows how much gold and how many items each player has put into and taken out of the guild bank

### Fixed

- The guild calendar prompt stops asking after every reload for a recruitment drive event SideQuest already saved, and says when a change is an update rather than a missing event

## v0.17.4 (2026-11-13)

### Fixed

- Update calendar edits a moved or wrong-type event in place over two clicks, since WoW: Forever doesn't let an addon delete a guild event, and names a cancelled one for you to delete by hand
